data.title: 结城明日奈 · 湖畔微风下的草地膝枕·「真是的……像小猫一样睡得这么香呢」
data.description: 22层湖畔的柳树筛下细碎光斑，亚丝娜坐在野餐布上，让你安静地枕着她的膝盖。她换了米白针织衫和柔软的藏青裙，一只手托着脸颊，另一手轻轻拨开你的额发。你从膝上睁开眼时，先看见她低头的笑脸，再看见她身后的柳叶和明亮湖水。树叶轻轻摇动，让光斑在她的笑脸旁缓缓移动。
data.location: 22层湖畔避世古树阴凉下的草坪
data.action: 坐在野餐布上提供膝枕，一手托腮，另一手轻拨视角额发，低头温柔微笑。
data.camera: POV close-up from the resting lap, looking upward
data.promptProse: Looking upward from Asuna's lap, see her gentle smile as she brushes her companion's forehead hair aside with one hand, the other supporting her cheek. She wears a cream knit top and soft navy skirt on the picnic cloth. Willow leaves hang behind her chestnut side braids, with the bright lake beyond. Moving leaves filter daylight across her cheek and cuffs, while reflected water softly brightens the underside of her face.
